preset.marketing.blog_article:concept_co.en: Approve the concept (check the topic, keywords, and outline)

preset.marketing.blog_article:pending_ap.ko: 제출한 초안이 발행 승인을 받을 때까지 기다리기(승인은 결재함의 초안에서)
preset.marketing.blog_article:pending_ap.en: Wait until the submitted draft is approved for publishing (approve it on the draft in Approvals)

preset.marketing.blog_article:planning.en: Plan the topic and keywords (title ideas and outline)

preset.marketing.blog_article:publish_ch.en: Check the published post at its public URL

preset.marketing.blog_article:published.ko: 승인된 초안을 블로그에 자동 발행(에이전트 할 일 없음)
preset.marketing.blog_article:published.en: The approved draft is published to the blog automatically (nothing for the agent to do)

preset.marketing.blog_article:verificati.ko: 콘텐츠 규칙 검수 후 초안 제출
preset.marketing.blog_article:verificati.en: Check the draft against the content rules, then submit it

preset.marketing.newsletter:campaign_cre.en: Create the Stibee campaign from the approved draft

preset.marketing.newsletter:review.ko: 내용 검수 후 캠페인 만들기 승인
preset.marketing.newsletter:review.en: Review the content and approve creating the campaign

preset.marketing.newsletter:send_request.ko: 받는 사람과 보낼 시각을 정해 발송 승인 요청
preset.marketing.newsletter:send_request.en: Set the recipients and send time, then request send approval

preset.marketing.social_card_news:budget.ko: 생성할 이미지와 예산을 정해 유료 생성 승인
preset.marketing.social_card_news:budget.en: Choose the images and budget, then approve paid generation

preset.marketing.social_card_news:concep.en: Approve the concept (check the message and card layout)

preset.marketing.social_card_news:draft.en: Write the plan draft (topic, message, card layout)

preset.marketing.social_card_news:editin.en: Attach images and write the caption

preset.marketing.social_card_news:pendin.en: Approve final publishing (right before it goes out)

preset.marketing.social_card_news:verifi.ko: 검증 시트 작성(이미지 속 글자·브랜드 표기 확인)
preset.marketing.social_card_news:verifi.en: Fill in the verification sheet (check text in images and brand names)

preset.marketing.social_text_post:concep.en: Approve the concept (check the message and tone)

preset.marketing.social_text_post:pendin.en: Approve final publishing (right before it goes out)

preset.marketing.video_production:animat.ko: 애니매틱 제작(무료 스틸·자막·내레이션) 후 구조 검토 요청
preset.marketing.video_production:animat.en: Make the animatic (free stills, subtitles, narration), then request a structure review

preset.marketing.video_production:concep.ko: 컨셉 승인(이야기와 제품 가치가 맞는지 확인)
preset.marketing.video_production:concep.en: Approve the concept (check the story fits the product's value)

preset.marketing.video_production:draft.en: Write the logline and concept draft

preset.marketing.video_production:editin.en: Finish the edit (color, background music, subtitle size)

preset.marketing.video_production:live_g.en: Run paid generation (key cuts, video, voice, lip sync)

preset.marketing.video_production:pendin.en: Approve final publishing (right before it goes out)

preset.marketing.video_production:struct.ko: 구조 확인 후 생성 대상과 예산을 정해 유료 생성 승인
preset.marketing.video_production:struct.en: Check the structure, choose what to generate and the budget, then approve paid generation

preset.marketing.video_production:verifi.ko: 검증 시트 작성(프레임·자막 받아쓰기로 화면과 소리 확인)
preset.marketing.video_production:verifi.en: Fill in the verification sheet (check picture and sound with frames and a subtitle transcript)

preset.workflow.agent_solo:execute.en: Do the work and produce the result

preset.workflow.agent_solo:received.en: Receive the event and understand the context

preset.workflow.agent_solo:report.en: Summarize the result and report it in chat

preset.workflow.kanban_simple:done_check.en: Check that the completion criteria are met

preset.workflow.kanban_simple:in_progres.en: Do the work and post progress updates

preset.workflow.kanban_simple:task_creat.en: Pick a task from the backlog and take it

preset.workflow.loop_agency:brief_doc_ap.ko: 실행 계획을 브리프 문서로 쓰고 문서 결재 받기
preset.workflow.loop_agency:brief_doc_ap.en: Write the plan as a brief and get it approved

preset.workflow.loop_agency:execute.en: Run the chosen option (publish a campaign, deploy, etc.)

preset.workflow.loop_agency:generate_var.ko: 브리프를 바탕으로 실행안 여러 개 만들기
preset.workflow.loop_agency:generate_var.en: Draft several options from the brief

preset.workflow.loop_agency:goal_hypothe.en: Set the goal, hypothesis, and metric

preset.workflow.loop_agency:loop_decisio.ko: 실행안 하나를 고르고, 고른 이유와 뺀 이유 남기기
preset.workflow.loop_agency:loop_decisio.en: Pick one option and note why, and why the others were dropped

preset.workflow.loop_agency:track_and_le.ko: 성과(GA4 등)를 재고, 고른 이유와 결과를 다음 실험의 참고로 남기기
preset.workflow.loop_agency:track_and_le.en: Measure results (e.g., GA4) and keep the choice, reasons, and results for the next cycle

preset.workflow.scrum_3step:implementati.en: Write the code and open a PR

preset.workflow.scrum_3step:kickoff.en: Write the spec and acceptance criteria

preset.workflow.scrum_3step:qa_review.ko: 완료 조건대로 확인하고 승인 또는 반려
preset.workflow.scrum_3step:qa_review.en: Check against the acceptance criteria, then approve or reject
